key.name: thresholds
key.description: JSON string containing an array of threshold objects with id, percent, direction, enabled, and label fields.

key.name: sound-file
key.description: Path to a custom .ogg/.wav/.mp3 file. Empty string means use the bundled default alarm sound.

key.name: alarm-volume
key.description: Volume level for the alarm sound, ranging from 0.0 (silent) to 1.0 (full volume).

key.name: sound-enabled
key.description: Whether to play an alarm sound when a threshold is reached.

key.name: repeat-count
key.summary: Number of times to repeat alarm
key.description: How many times the alarm sound will play when a threshold is triggered.

key.name: cooldown-minutes
key.description: Minimum minutes between successive alarms for the same threshold, preventing alarm spam.

key.name: notifications-enabled
key.description: Whether to show a desktop notification when a threshold is reached.

key.name: quiet-hours-enabled
key.description: Silence alarms during specified quiet hours.

key.name: quiet-hours-start
key.description: Time (HH:MM, 24h format) when quiet hours begin.

key.name: quiet-hours-end
key.description: Time (HH:MM, 24h format) when quiet hours end.

key.name: show-panel-indicator
key.description: Whether to show a battery alarm indicator icon in the top panel.

key.name: show-percentage-in-panel
key.description: Whether to show the current battery percentage next to the panel indicator.

key.name: muted
key.description: Temporarily mute all battery alarms. Can be toggled from the panel indicator.

key.name: last-alarm-times
key.summary: Last alarm trigger times per threshold
key.description: JSON object mapping threshold IDs to their last trigger timestamp, used for cooldown logic.

key.name: stop-alarm-on-unplug
key.summary: Stop alarm when charger is unplugged
key.description: Automatically stop the alarm sound and visual alert when the charger is disconnected from the device.

key.name: visual-alert-enabled
key.description: Flash a colored border around the screen edges when a threshold is triggered. Useful in quiet environments where sound is not appropriate.

key.name: visual-alert-color
key.description: Hex color string (e.g. #00CC66) for the screen-edge blinking visual alert.

key.name: visual-alert-duration
key.description: How many seconds the screen-edge flash runs. Set to 0 to keep flashing until the charger is unplugged or the alarm is manually stopped.
